errors.evidence: The description fails to mention the solid blue line, which represents the actual annual data. It only mentions the dotted trend line.

errors.text_span: 图表上有一条蓝色的虚线，它在1946年左右从大约3.3的值开始，到1950年下降到大约3.15，然后到1954年回升到大约3.25。 在1954年和1982年之间，该线呈波动状态，从大约3.2到大约3.3不等，在1982年达到一个峰值，大约为3.45。 从1982年到2018年，该线主要向下波动，于2014年左右下降到大约2.9的值，最后在2018年略微回升到大约3.0。
errors.evidence: The description claims to be describing the dotted line ('虚线'), but all the specific values and fluctuations it mentions (e.g., the peak at ~3.45, the dip to ~2.9) correspond to the solid line. The actual dotted line shows a much smoother, gradual decline.
The chart shows the first significant dip is to approximately 3.2 in 1948, not to 3.15 in 1950. The value in 1950 is approximately 3.3.
The main peak in the data occurs around the year 1988, not 1982. The value in 1982 is approximately 3.3, whereas the peak in 1988 is at approximately 3.45.
